limitations: 0.4percent resistor total and200ppm additional reference drift are allocations, not selected-part/lifetime qualification.
DC controller interpolates LED current continuously with overdrive. It does not implement hysteresis, a latch, startup, detector saturation or a real comparator transfer curve.
Monitor8.2V rail is ideal. Positive sink current proves steady supply budget only; select/qualify shunt regulator, bias, clamp and capacitors separately.
Generic NPN BF20 and optocoupler CTR25percent are sensitivity assumptions, not guaranteed hot parts.
Source BJT is transformed into an exactly equivalent local-voltage wrapper to avoid invalid common-mode operating points. This is numerical adaptation, not a change to transistor physics.
Small-signal AC comparison uses existing simplified tube/transformer/effects models at one knob setting per channel; no clipping, noise or hardware claim.
Planned100k reference preload keeps REF3425 sourcing despite comparator input current. It is included in the quiet-current allocation; the reference/comparator are not transistor-level models.
done_condition: Reproducible tolerance comparison, balanced coupled DC cases and small-signal response comparison; preserve failures and native hashes.
human_check: Exact monitor/actuator parts, aging, sockets, startup/fault timing, reverse paths, thermal fit and protected prototype measurements remain required.
